description: This file defines the Env class, which manages environment variables for the application, including loading defaults and fetching specific configuration values.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Provides static methods and properties to load and access environment variables, with default fallbacks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file, with fallback defaults if loading fails.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or default.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL for real-time updates from environment variables or default.

methods.name: eventsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for events from environment variables or default.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Returns whether mock mode is enabled, interpreting various string representations.
